name: Retool
priceNote: Team, per builder, billed yearly (+$5 per internal user)

agent.name: Replit Agent
does: Builds internal tools and dashboards from a description
Sets up a database and deploys the app
Plans work before building in plan mode
Runs several agents in parallel on Pro

whatYouLose: Built-in permissions, SSO and audit controls for internal apps
notes: Replit Agent writes a real custom app instead of configuring Retool blocks. That gives more freedom, but someone has to own the code.
